title.zh: 吕勒奥群岛与冰上公路

summary.en: Driving on the frozen sea (Ice Roads) is official but carries risks. Speed limit is usually 30 km/h to prevent creating waves under the ice that can crack it.
summary.zh: 在冰冻的海面（冰上公路）上驾驶是官方允许的，但有风险。限速通常为 30 公里/小时，以防止在冰下产生可能导致冰裂的波浪。

mitigations.en: Strictly adhere to the 30 km/h speed limit.
mitigations.zh: 严格遵守 30 公里/小时的限速。

mitigations.en: Do not stop the car near other cars (distribute weight).
mitigations.zh: 不要在其他车辆附近停车（分散重量）。

mitigations.en: Keep seatbelt OFF if advised by locals (rare, but traditional for quick escape), though modern rules usually say ON.
mitigations.zh: 如果当地人建议，请解开安全带（罕见，但在传统上是为了快速逃生），尽管现代规则通常要求系好。

items.en: Visit Gammelstad Church Town (UNESCO Heritage) - Visitor center has limited winter hours.
items.zh: 参观加默尔斯塔德教堂村（UNESCO 遗产）- 游客中心冬季开放时间有限。

items.en: Rent 'Kicksled' (Spark) for local transport on ice.
items.zh: 租用 'Kicksled'（Spark，一种冰上滑板车）作为冰上交通工具。

items.en: Verify ice road status (Isbanan) - usually opens Jan-Mar.
items.zh: 核实冰上公路（Isbanan）状态 - 通常 1 月至 3 月开放。

message.en: Luleå is home to a major Air Force base (F 21). There are large restricted no-fly zones for drones. Checking the drone map is mandatory.
message.zh: 吕勒奥是一个主要空军基地 (F 21) 的所在地。有大片无人机禁飞区。强制要求查看无人机地图。
